Not trailing spend.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM finops-rightsizing-latest*\\n| WHERE finops.rightsizing.status IN (\\\"open\\\", \\\"in_progress\\\")\\n| EVAL account = CASE(\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"985408759551\\\", \\\"apm-stage\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"041298796264\\\", \\\"monitoring / elastic-integration\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"439106060789\\\", \\\"ESF (439106060789)\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"119672459156\\\", \\\"ESF (119672459156)\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id\\n)\\n| STATS identified = ROUND(SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings), 2), recs = COUNT(*)\\n    BY account\\n| SORT identified DESC\\n| LIMIT 12\"}}, \"encoding\": {\"y\": {\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\", \"sort\": \"-x\", \"axis\": {\"labelLimit\": 220, \"labelPadding\": 4, \"grid\": false}}, \"x\": {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Identified USD / mo\", \"axis\": {\"grid\": true, \"tickCount\": 5}}}, \"layer\": [{\"mark\": {\"type\": \"bar\", \"cornerRadiusEnd\": 3, \"tooltip\": true, \"height\": {\"band\": 0.72}}, \"encoding\": {\"color\": {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"scale\": {\"scheme\": \"blues\"}, \"legend\": null}, \"tooltip\": [{\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\"}, {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Identified USD / mo\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}]}}, {\"mark\": {\"type\": \"text\", \"align\": \"left\", \"baseline\": \"middle\", \"dx\": 4, \"fontSize\": 11, \"color\": \"#343741\"}, \"encoding\": {\"text\": {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}}}], \"config\": {\"view\": {\"stroke\": null}, \"axis\": {\"labelFontSize\": 11, \"titleFontSize\": 12, \"domain\": false}}}"}}
